programs.title: Hitler's Power
programs.desc: Discussion of the events that led to Hitler's rise to power.In addition, the authors will discuss what happened after he became Führer.Viewers will learn why he was confident of public support.

programs.title: Nazi Megastructures: Russia's War
programs.desc: One of Hitler's aspirations was to liquidate the Russian nation in order to gain living space for the Aryans.The German army reached the outskirts of Moscow, but the Red Army managed to stop the attack.

programs.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the fight against the international cocaine trade in the Caribbean.AMO agents and DHS investigators conduct intensive operations in Puerto Rico and neighboring islands, thwarting smuggling attempts.

programs.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt: Four Queens Compilation
programs.desc: In ancient Egypt, royal power was reserved for men, but over the centuries, women also sat on the throne.Some ruled as queens, others were crowned pharaoh.The figures of Cleopatra and Nefertiti still exist in popular culture today.The former, due to her alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony, was remembered as an ambitious ruler of extraordinary beauty who excelled in the role of a politician and strategist.Her dramatic fate and suicide death have fired up the imagination of subsequent generations for over two thousand years.The authors will also talk about other extraordinary Egyptian women.Viewers will learn the fate of Hatshepsut, who was the longest-reigning female pharaoh, and Nefertari, the influential wife of Ramesses II.All of them went down in the history of this highly developed civilization.The creators will explain how they reached for titles and power.

programs.title: The Spying Game: Tales from the Cold War
programs.desc: The creators of the program talk about operations undertaken during the Cold War by intelligence officers of the United States of America, the Soviet Union and other countries.

programs.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique
programs.desc: Millions of people were sent to forced labor camps in the USSR, including many Poles.Often their fate remained unknown.Not only criminals were sent there, but also political opponents and citizens who offended the system.Cheap labor in mines, quarries and logging was to support the economy.All documents have not yet been declassified.Knowledge about labor camps can be derived, among others, from literature - "The Gulag Archipelago" by Alexander Solzhenitsyn or "Another World" by Gustaw Herling-Grudziński.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: While landing in Düsseldorf, the turboprop flying Nürnberger Flugdienst 108 crashes. Everyone on board is killed.As part of the investigation, elements of the wreck from the disaster area should be secured.The experts face a real challenge - they must reconstruct the entire machine to determine the causes of the tragedy.The discovery of evidence of a lightning strike is a breakthrough in the case.It turns out that the discharge damaged the electrical system, which resulted in a loss of power.

programs.title: Area 51: The CIA's Secret Files
programs.desc: The documentary presents the history of "Area 51", an air military base located in the desert near Las Vegas.The base was established in 1955, but its existence was officially confirmed only in 2013.This place is shrouded in legends because it is surrounded by a prohibited air zone of 1,140 square kilometers.The base developed programs that determined American dominance in military aviation from the Cold War to operations in Iraq and Afghanistan.Spy planes tested there were often mistaken for UFOs.The film features eyewitnesses to the creation of subsequent super-secret projects.Declassified CIA documents were used in the production.
